from machine import Pin, SPI
from time import sleep_ms

spi = SPI(0, baudrate=8000000, polarity=0, phase=0, sck=Pin(18), mosi=Pin(19), miso=Pin(16))
cs = Pin(17, Pin.OUT, value=1)
dc = Pin(20, Pin.OUT, value=1)
rst = Pin(21, Pin.OUT, value=1)

def tft_cmd(cmd):
    cs.off()
    dc.off()
    spi.write(bytes((cmd & 0xFF,)))
    cs.on()

def tft_data(payload):
    cs.off()
    dc.on()
    spi.write(payload)
    cs.on()

def tft_init():
    rst.off()
    sleep_ms(20)
    rst.on()
    sleep_ms(120)
    tft_cmd(0x01)
    sleep_ms(120)
    tft_cmd(0x11)
    sleep_ms(120)
    tft_cmd(0x3A)
    tft_data(bytes((0x55,)))
    tft_cmd(0x29)
    sleep_ms(20)

print("MP_TFT_BOOT")
init_ok = True
try:
    tft_init()
except Exception as exc:
    init_ok = False
    print("MP_TFT_INIT_ERR", exc)

print("MP_TFT_INIT", 1 if init_ok else 0)
print("MP_TFT_STEP", 0, "OK", 1 if init_ok else 0, "COLOR", 0x07E0)
print("MP_TFT_DONE")
